description: This PHP source file is responsible for rendering the list view of documents in the vtiger CRM system. It manages user permissions, view sessions, sorting, filtering, folder management, and dynamically generates the list view interface with support for AJAX updates.

classes.name: CustomView
classes.description: Handles custom view configurations for the document list view, including view IDs, permissions, and filter settings.

classes.name: ListViewSession
classes.description: Manages session-based state for list views, including sorting and pagination.

classes.name: QueryGenerator
classes.description: Generates database queries for fetching document records based on user filters, sorting, and custom views.

classes.name: ListViewController
classes.description: Controls the retrieval and display logic for list view entries, including search, sorting, and pagination.

classes.name: Documents
classes.description: Represents the Documents module entity, manages initialization and folder-related functionalities.

methods.name: initSortbyField
methods.description: Initializes the sorting fields for the Documents module.

methods.name: getViewId
methods.description: Fetches the current view ID for the context.

methods.name: getCustomViewCombo
methods.description: Returns HTML for custom view selection dropdown.

methods.name: getCustomViewByCvid
methods.description: Returns details about the current custom view.

methods.name: getOrderBy
methods.description: Retrieves the current field by which listings are sorted.

methods.name: getSortOrderForFolder
methods.description: Retrieves the sort order specific to a folder.

methods.name: getOrderByForFolder
methods.description: Retrieves the order by field specific to a folder.

methods.name: getListViewHeader
methods.description: Constructs the header for the list view table.

methods.name: getListViewEntries
methods.description: Fetches the entries (rows) for display in the list view.
